train_vae_model: train a convolutional VAE on binarized MNIST using JAX Haiku and Optax with configurable batch size and latent dimensions
run_train_step: run a single VAE training step computing loss gradients and updating optimizer state with Adam
save_vae_images: save reconstructed training images and sampled images as PNG plots during VAE training validation
save_vae_checkpoint: save trained VAE model parameters to a pickle file in the specified output directory
run_vae_training_cli: run the VAE training script from the command line using an absl config file for hyperparameters
